evals.name: light-refactor
evals.prompt: 重构这个 Vue 3 函数，嵌套太深了：function processData(items) { const result = []; for (const item of items) { if (item.active) { if (item.type === 'A') { if (item.value > 100) { result.push({ ...item, processed: true }); } } } } return result; }
evals.expected_output: 使用 Guard Clause 扁平化嵌套，提取魔法值 100 为常量，不改命名约定，不拆分文件（LIGHT 路径）
assertions: uses-guard-clause: Uses guard clause (early return) to flatten nesting
extracts-magic-number: Extracts magic number 100 to a named constant
no-file-split: Does not create new files or directories
preserves-naming: Preserves existing variable/function names
light-path: Follows LIGHT path (no architecture changes, no new modules)

evals.name: medium-vue-component
evals.prompt: 用 Vue 3 Composition API 创建一个 UserList 组件，展示用户列表，支持搜索过滤和分页。需要处理 loading、empty、error 三种状态。
evals.expected_output: Vue 3 SFC 组件，使用 Composition API，覆盖四态（loading/empty/error/success），使用 BEM 命名，引用 CSS 变量 token，遵循 DDD 分层
assertions: uses-composition-api: Uses <script setup> with Composition API (ref/computed/watch)
covers-four-states: Implements loading, empty, error, and success states
uses-bem-naming: CSS classes follow BEM naming convention
uses-css-variables: References CSS custom properties (var(--xxx)) instead of hardcoded colors
has-search-filter: Implements search filter functionality
has-pagination: Implements pagination
ddd-layered: Component is placed in correct DDD layer (not mixing domain/UI logic)

evals.name: heavy-module-setup
evals.prompt: 搭建一个用户管理模块的前端项目结构，包含列表页、详情页、编辑表单。使用 Vue 3 + TypeScript + Pinia。需要 DDD 分层架构。
evals.expected_output: 完整的 DDD 分层目录结构（domain/application/infrastructure/presentation），每层职责清晰，含 API 契约设计和基础设施配置
assertions: ddd-vertical-slice: Uses DDD vertical slice architecture (feature-based, not layer-based)
ddd-horizontal-layers: Has clear horizontal layers (domain/application/infrastructure/presentation)
layer-boundary-clean: No cross-layer dependency violations (domain doesn't import infrastructure)
uses-typescript: Uses TypeScript with proper type definitions
uses-pinia: Uses Pinia for state management in application layer
has-api-contract: Defines API contract with typed request/response interfaces
four-states-covered: List page covers loading/empty/error/success states

evals.name: react-hooks-pattern
evals.prompt: 用 React + TypeScript 创建一个 useFetch hook，支持请求取消、错误重试、loading 状态。然后写一个使用这个 hook 的 DataGrid 组件。
evals.expected_output: 自定义 Hook 遵循 React Hooks 规范，DataGrid 组件覆盖四态，使用 SCSS Modules + BEM
assertions: hook-rules: Custom hook follows React Hooks rules (no conditional hooks, proper dependency array)
request-cancellation: Implements AbortController for request cancellation
error-retry: Implements error retry mechanism
four-states: DataGrid covers loading/empty/error/success states
uses-scss-modules: Uses SCSS Modules (.module.scss) with BEM naming
uses-css-variables: References CSS custom properties for theming

evals.name: api-design-review
evals.prompt: Review 这个 REST API 设计并指出问题：GET /api/getUserList?type=1&status=active&limit=20&page=1 返回 { code: 200, msg: 'success', data: { list: [...], total: 100 } }。POST /api/createUser 传 { name: '张三', age: 25 } 返回 { code: 200, msg: 'success' }
evals.expected_output: 指出 RESTful 命名问题（动词在 URL）、缺少错误码体系、响应格式不规范、缺少分页元数据、缺少版本控制
assertions: flags-restful-naming: Identifies non-RESTful URL naming (getUserList should be GET /api/users)
flags-error-codes: Identifies missing HTTP status codes and error code system
flags-response-format: Identifies non-standard response format (code/msg/data wrapper issues)
flags-pagination-meta: Identifies missing pagination metadata (total/page/limit in headers or meta)
flags-versioning: Identifies missing API versioning (/v1/ or header-based)
suggests-fixes: Provides concrete fix directions for each issue
